findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 1 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.
Book correction: The book prints "and is written as 1". The product of a non-zero real number b and i is written as bi (or ib), as the examples 2i, -3i, \sqrt{5}\,i, -\frac{11}{2}i show.

Book correction: The book prints "5 - 4i is complex conjugate of 5 - 4i". Changing the sign of the imaginary part of 5 - 4i gives 5 + 4i, so 5 + 4i is the complex conjugate of 5 - 4i (and 5 - 4i is the complex conjugate of 5 + 4i).
